steps.title: Slotted bar (four arrangements): extrude the bar
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as slotted_bar.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XY Plane (the front). Draw a rectangle 120 long and 48 high, corner on the origin.
Finish Sketch. Extrude: Profile = the rectangle, Distance 25. OK.

steps.title: Slotted bar (four arrangements): cut step 1 (17 wide, 6 up)
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the front face. Draw a rectangle 17 wide and 6 high on the bottom edge, starting 0 from the left end.
Finish Sketch. Extrude: Profile = the rectangle, Cut, Through All. OK.

steps.note: The slides show this bar with no numbers (they teach the arrangement, not the sizes). The 120 length and the step sizes are scaled from slide 7. On the drawing it is dimensioned four ways: parallel, running, chain and combined.
